plan.goal: Autonomously explore and critique the UX of the full lattice system, prioritizing the primary pricing flow plus adjacent pages, states, and recovery paths.
plan.summary: The exploration will start on the landing page to verify navigation and basic layout, before dedicating the majority of effort to the complex pricing page. The pricing page evaluation will focus on the interactive 2D matrix, state updates in the sticky quote card, tier highlighting, and the add-on calculator logic. Finally, the run will heavily evaluate how this large matrix and sticky layout perform on a mobile viewport.
assumptions: Clicking a `td` cell in the pricing matrix triggers JavaScript state changes on the page.
The sticky quote card and bottom fee breakdown update dynamically based on cell selection and add-on checkbox states.
The 'How this is calculated' section is an expandable element (accordion/details).
risk_hotspots: Responsiveness and usability of the 6x6 pricing matrix on mobile.
Behavior of the sticky quote card overlapping or breaking layout on smaller screens.
Accuracy of the dynamic calculations when combining flat-fee and percentage-based add-ons.
Navigation links identified as having small tap targets.

phases.title: Landing Page & Navigation
phases.objective: Verify the basic structure, branding, and navigation paths from the landing page.
key_checks: Check global header links and note the small tap targets reported in the prescan.
Ensure the 'See pricing' CTA properly routes to the pricing page.
exit_criteria: Navigated successfully to pricing.html via CTA.

phases.title: Pricing Matrix Interaction (Desktop)
phases.objective: Validate the core interactive 2D matrix for seat/data volume selection.
key_checks: Click multiple cells (e.g., $169, $659, Contact us) and verify that row/column highlighting updates.
Verify that the 'SELECTED CELL' in the quote card updates with the correct dollar amount and tier.
Verify that clicking a cell correctly auto-highlights the corresponding tier in the 4-tier explainer section.
exit_criteria: Multiple distinct cells selected with confirmed state changes in the DOM/UI.

phases.title: Add-ons & Calculator Logic
phases.objective: Test the behavior of add-on checkboxes and the final fee breakdown.
key_checks: Expand the 'How we got this number' / 'How this is calculated' section.
Toggle a mix of flat-fee (e.g., +$400/mo) and percentage-based (+15%) add-ons.
Verify the bottom final monthly-fee breakdown card calculates the expected total.
exit_criteria: Add-ons toggled and calculator breakdown visually updated.

phases.title: Mobile Viewport Stress Test
phases.objective: Evaluate the complex table and calculator on mobile.
key_checks: Attempt to scroll and interact with the 6x6 matrix (check for horizontal scrolling or layout breakage).
Observe the positioning of the sticky quote card—does it block the viewport?
exit_criteria: Matrix and calculator interactions completed and screenshotted under mobile constraints.

coverage_targets.features: Exercise matrix cell selection, tier highlighting, quote expansion, and all add-on types.
coverage_targets.mobile: Strictly evaluate the horizontal overflow of the pricing table and the usability of the sticky calculator on mobile.

notes: The prescan highlighted multiple 'small_tap_target' warnings on nav links. Note this in the final UX critique.
Be sure to click at least one 'Contact us' cell in the matrix to see how the calculator handles non-numeric states.
